scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @hemmia/server" "npm run dev -w @hemmia/web"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test && npm run site:check
scripts.check:all: npm run check && cd services/imagegen && uv run --frozen pytest -q
scripts.mobile:build: npm run build -w @hemmia/mobile && npm run sync -w @hemmia/mobile
scripts.mobile:ios: npm run mobile:build && npx -w @hemmia/mobile cap open ios
scripts.mobile:android: npm run mobile:build && npx -w @hemmia/mobile cap open android
